verdict.rationale: Docs mention org-level Role Based Access Control and SSO (Okta/Azure AD/SAML/OIDC) for enterprise accounts, which relates to access control, but there is no evidence of scoped or least-privilege API keys/credentials specifically for individual agents or automated processes. missing for 10: documented API key scoping, per-key permission granularity, agent-specific credential issuance, and any first-party guidance on least-privilege key management.
